chain.title: The Cutter That Names Its Material
chain.desc: Iron, logs and a stone slab. The Architect's Cutter is the only way to make Domum's shingles, timber frames, pillars and panels, and it takes two inputs so one shape can wear any material.

chain.title: Bricks With The Mortar Showing
chain.desc: Four bricks in a square. Extra Bricks are the textured base the coloured brick family is dyed from.

chain.title: Cobble, Tidied
chain.desc: The same trick on cobblestone. Domum's whole philosophy is one recipe shape and many materials.

chain.title: Brick And Gravel
chain.desc: Bricks shaken with gravel. Beige is the first of the tinted brick sets and the standard wall of most MineColonies styles.

chain.title: Stone Brick, Weathered
chain.desc: Stone bricks with terracotta. The stone-brick half of the tint family, used for the foundations builders lay first.

chain.title: Green Planks From The Desert
chain.desc: Cactus pressed into a plank-like block. Domum treats cactus as a building material rather than a hazard.

chain.title: Walls You Can See Through
chain.desc: Paper worked into a panel. It feeds the paper wall and tiled paper wall the Architect's Cutter produces.

chain.title: A Barrel That Is Only A Barrel
chain.desc: Planks and a stick. Purely decorative barrels, standing or laid on their side, that colony schematics scatter through storerooms.

chain.title: Carpet Off The Floor
chain.desc: Wool and string. A floating carpet hangs with no block beneath it, which is how colony builders drape banners and awnings.

chain.title: Thatch
chain.desc: Wheat compressed into a block. The roof of every farmhouse a builder will ever put up for you.

notes: SHORT CHAIN PLUS WHEELS BY DESIGN, AND SAID PLAINLY: Domum Ornamentum is a decorative variant set. It is the block library MineColonies builders draw from, and roughly a hundred of its blocks are 'materialized' - one registered block whose displayed name and texture come from the material baked into its NBT. Those have blockstates and models but NO static lang key, which is why item.domum_ornamentum.* / block.domum_ornamentum.* covers only 29 entries in a jar with 118 item models. Ids are verified two ways: the 29 with lang keys, plus blocks whose assets/domum_ornamentum/blockstates/<path>.json matches a data/domum_ornamentum/recipes result - a blockstate path IS the block registry path. The right shape here is a short spine ending at the Architect's Cutter plus two variant wheels (the tinted brick family, the fourteen floating carpets), not a padded 20-step ladder. The Cutter is the only genuinely mechanical quest in the mod: it is a two-input cutter, so every shingle, timber frame, pillar, panel, fancy door and light block is one recipe wearing a different material. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: nothing - Domum Ornamentum has no mandatory mod dependency and works from vanilla brick, stone, wool and wood.
